title: Materials and Textures
text:
Every object is made of a material. Wood, glass, and metal are common materials. Each material has its own texture. Glass is smooth and cold. Wood can be rough.

Soft materials feel nice to touch. A cotton shirt is soft, but a stone floor is hard. Many people like soft blankets when they are cold. Hard materials are good for tables and chairs.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what is glass like?
According to the second paragraph, what is a cotton shirt like?
What can you infer about why people choose cotton for shirts?
options: It feels comfortable against the skin
It is very heavy to wear
It is always cold to touch
It is hard and difficult to bend

questions.text: What can you infer about walking on the stone floor without shoes?
options: It would feel soft under your feet
It would feel hard under your feet
It would feel like a warm blanket

vocabulary.definition: how something feels when you touch it
easy to press and not hard

paragraph_translations: Każdy przedmiot jest zrobiony z materiału. Drewno, szkło i metal to popularne materiały. Każdy materiał ma swoją fakturę. Szkło jest gładkie i zimne. Drewno może być szorstkie.
Miękkie materiały są przyjemne w dotyku. Bawełniana koszula jest miękka, ale kamienna podłoga jest twarda. Wiele osób lubi miękkie koce, gdy jest zimno. Twarde materiały są dobre na stoły i krzesła.
